title: synphasor: improved compliance with the standard
description:
- According to the standard, number of channels occupies 2 bytes which is uint16_t, not int.
- Fixed typos.

notes.body: changed title from **{-ref-}: improved compliance with the standard** to **{+synphasor+}: improved compliance with the standard**
I think offset type should not be changed.
According to the standard, frame size presented as 16-bit unsigned number. Therefore, the offset used for iteration through the frame can also be represented as uint16_t.

Having a lager variable poses no problem and offset used trough out the
code base is an int which is what the tvb function take as input.

skrev:
Okay, I'll change the offset to int.
